I'm a fourth-year statistics and data science undergrad at UC Santa Barbara,
aiming at a meaningful career in biostatistics.

## What I work on

My coursework has run through the probability and stochastic processes
sequence, regression and GLMs, and statistical machine learning. This fall I'm 
excited to be taking methods of analysis and survival analysis courses.

This summer I was a part of ISI-BUDS, an NIH-funded biostatistics research
program at UC Irvine, learning under amazing faculty and PhDs. The focal point 
was working on a real research problem investigating vector abundance in the
Coachella Valley. 

Right now I'm gearing up for grad school apps and strengthening my R skills.
ISI-BUDS was an incredible experience and validated what I hope to be doing.
